places.quote: Little Dorrit took him by the Iron Bridge and sat him down there for a rest
places.note: Dickens's name for Southwark Bridge, which is the bridge the passage means; the name is an informal one used in the novel.

places.quote: the Father of the Marshalsea was sauntering towards the Lodge at the moment when they were coming out of it
places.note: Debtors' prison; 'this College' is also used for it. The Lodge is the prison gatehouse.
